name: connection.tier_raise
description: Raise the connection's tier on the strict ladder (read < create < update < delete < extra_risky). Token-gated.

tier.description: Target tier. Must be reachable from the current tier.

token.description: Contents of the agent's token file. Wrong token returns `ERR auth_invalid`.

new_tier.description: Tier now active on the connection. Equals the requested tier on success.

x-implementations.name: agent_native
x-implementations.description: Handled inline by the agent's lifecycle layer. Token verification reads the per-family token file and compares constant-time.

windows-modern.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb. Token file path and ACL are declared on the family record in spec/families.json.

windows-classic.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb. Token file path and ACL are declared on the family record in spec/families.json. NTFS-only ACL enforcement applies; FAT32 hosts cannot enforce per-user read restriction.
